evals.name: codex-trio-default-runs-exactly-three-subagents
evals.prompt: Review these staged changes adversarially before I merge them.
evals.expected_output: Runs exactly three ordinary fresh Codex subagents, labels their results as codex-skeptic / Skeptic, codex-architect / Architect, and codex-minimalist / Minimalist, then returns a PASS, CONTESTED, or REJECT verdict.

evals.name: each-lens-is-represented-once
evals.prompt: Challenge this refactor plan before implementation.
evals.expected_output: Assigns Skeptic, Architect, and Minimalist once each, keeps the lenses separate, and synthesizes accepted versus rejected findings.

evals.name: sandbox-inheritance-is-stated-accurately
evals.prompt: Review the Codex subagent reviewer path and its isolation claim.
evals.expected_output: States that Codex subagents inherit the parent sandbox and approval state, and does not overclaim stronger isolation.

evals.name: incomplete-coverage-fails-closed
evals.prompt: Run an adversarial review when one required Codex subagent cannot complete.
evals.expected_output: Does not silently drop the failed reviewer, records the coverage failure with an allowed failure label, and returns CONTESTED unless an accepted high-severity finding already requires REJECT.

evals.name: no-outside-reviewer-fallback
evals.prompt: Run an adversarial review when only one reviewer path appears available.
evals.expected_output: Does not call external model tools or a single-reviewer fallback, requires the full Codex subagent trio, and reports incomplete coverage when the trio cannot run.

evals.name: no-review-artifact-files-by-default
evals.prompt: Run an adversarial review and save the result in the final answer.
evals.expected_output: Collects returned subagent messages and synthesizes in the final answer without creating temporary review files by default.
